name: switch
title: Switch
description: An on and off switch. Its sewing-button thumb rolls as it slides.

.tx-switch-thumb.background:
radial-gradient(circle at 38% 38%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.6px, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 62% 38%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.6px, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 38% 62%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.6px, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 62% 62%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.6px, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle, var(--tx-rivet-light) 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tx-rivet-light) 70%, var(--tx-rivet)) 100%)
